text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — draft for the launch post chart ready. Thinking a compact two-line sparkline that compares latency (ms) and cost ($/1k tokens) across three model configs. Want to settle headline + caption tomorrow. figma -> https://www.figma.com/file/REDWOOD/latency-cost?node-id=12
sam: Love the two-line idea. One ask: use a log scale for cost so the fat tail doesn't crush the visual. Keeps the story about latency improvements visible.
martin: Can we also surface percent savings? Eg 'up to 3x cheaper per token at 95th pct latency' — helps PMs and finance teams immediately.
elaine: @martin good call. Draft headline options so far: (A) "Fast and fair: sub-100ms latency at lower cost" (B) "Cut inference cost without the latency hit" — we should A/B test.
tia: Option A reads better for dev audiences. Also add a 1-line caption noting quantization + batching assumptions (so we don't overclaim).
ops-bot: deploy-preview built: https://deployments.redwood.ai/preview/342 — chart PNGs uploaded to /assets/latency_cost_v1.png.
sam: Quick label sketch for the designer 
```
x: request size (tokens)
y-left: latency (ms)
y-right: cost ($ / 1k tokens) [log scale]
caption: measurements on sample T=1k, batching=dynamic, quant=8-bit
```
martin: One more routing piece: CTA mapping in the post should route enterprise leads to Dedicated /sales form, SMB to hosted free-trial. We can add hidden UTM tags for the A/B headlines to measure conversion.
elaine: Perfect — I'll update the figma with Martin's CTA map and Sam's scale notes. Meeting tomorrow 10:00am to lock final copy and the two headline variants. :thumbsup:
tia: I left two short tweet drafts + webinar slide notes in figma comments for the copywriter.
notes: Decisions to lock: headline A/B, log-scale cost, percent savings line, CTA routing, caption with assumptions
